paragraphs: JailCore sells cloud-based inmate management software that lets Correctional Officers document cell checks and observations, head counts, location changes and inmate interactions on a handheld rugged mobile device. Collected data is transmitted to JailCore OPS, the Command Staff's Observational Patrol System, where supervisor-level staff members view it in real-time and are alerted to past-due observations.

The homepage presents the platform as a replacement for paper logs and describes NFC-driven technology that verifies staff presence. The about page says the solution covers a jail housing as few as 50 inmates or as many as 5,000.

quote.text: Free your jail from tedious paperwork and liability.
